items.area: Shared scalar fold C rendering and serialization
items.reason: Upstream 800f589b4 and 9e8de45a5 provide fold rendering plus continuation semantics. Original NestedParameterFold renders for FMI 2 and FMI 3 and executes via FastDyn on upstream.
Upstream 5c954bb73 implements map rendering, including negative/non-divisible iteration steps.

Concrete ParameterReduction compiles on upstream but FMI rendering fails with unsupported-feature:fmi.c.pure-call: tensor reduce. Port supports Real binary64 sum/product/min/max and Boolean all, using current arithmetic helpers and first-element accumulation.

items.decision: Do not transplant in this PR
items.reason: Original parameter-fold sources pass current upstream checked admission. Old code predates continuation and slice contracts; transplanting it is unnecessary for the reproduced generation defect. No claim is made that every scalar-fold dependency form is supported.
Upstream already starts the initialization solve from the unsettled coordinate; the source-branch delta from v0.10.1 in initialization_solver_y is explanatory text.

items.area: Native trace publication, bitcode and ModelSan/frontend changes
items.decision: Exclude from this FMI C-generation PR
items.reason: They are outside the selected upstream PR scope; source branch is preserved.
